prompt: Create a simple full-body cartoon illustration of a standing bear character on a plain off-white background. The bear is centered and front-facing, drawn in a playful naive doodle style with very thick, uneven black outlines, rounded shapes, and minimal detail. The body is mostly warm white, tall and pear-shaped, with short rounded legs, dangling arms, and small three-bump paws. The face has two large circular startled eyes with tiny black pupils, round ears with pink inner circles, and a long vertical teardrop-shaped snout colored soft peach-orange. Add one oval black nose near the lower part of the snout with a tiny vertical line below it, giving the bear a blank surprised expression. Include exactly 14 faint beige short dash marks scattered down the belly as subtle fur spots. Keep the composition clean, flat, hand-drawn, childlike, and slightly imperfect, with no text, no shadows, no scenery, and no extra characters.

promptZh: 创作一张简单的全身卡通插画，描绘一个站在纯色灰白色背景上的熊角色。熊位于画面中心，正面朝向，采用俏皮的天真涂鸦风格绘制，具有非常粗且不均匀的黑色轮廓、圆润的形状和极简的细节。身体大部分为 暖白色，高大且呈梨形，配有短而圆的腿、下垂的手臂和带有三个小凸起的手掌。面部有两个巨大的圆形惊恐眼睛，瞳孔极小，圆耳朵内侧带有粉色圆圈，以及一个长长的垂直泪滴状吻部，颜色为 柔和桃橙色。在吻部下方添加一个椭圆形的黑色鼻子，下方有一条极小的垂直线，使熊呈现出一种呆滞且惊讶的表情。在腹部散布 14 个淡淡的米色短横线作为细微的毛发斑点。保持构图简洁、扁平、手绘感、童趣且略带不完美，不要包含任何文字、阴影、背景或额外角色。
